name: Hiya Tatsuo
source:
He is a school teacher, 29 years old and a virgin.  He is a weak man with no sense of fashion. He is often teased by students who are younger than him. He believes that if the students are having a good time, than it's fine.

However, his inner self is that of a hustler, and on the internet he is incredibly aggressive, he is what you call, a keyboard warrior. His only hobby is to go home from work and enjoy his new erotic works.

He became a teacher in the hopes of living out his games, but of course, nothing like that is ever happening. He is living a life that is basically no good, but one incident changes his life forever.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240721011027/http://chiroame.sakura.ne.jp/game/003/kyara.html] archived official site[/url]]
